title: ChessFlyStatePings: retained history changes a frozen receiver; continuation targeting fails
summary: Extends the frozen ChessFly connectome harness from residue sensitivity through receiver and listener geometry to a controlled same-present assay. Twelve opposite-order cue pairs across four common positions receive one identical delayed ping. Retained history changes the response, but the declared native-continuation targeting gate fails: 13/24 policy pairings (54.2%), 68.2% matched-control percentile and negative native alignment. The first structurally zero-ping attempt is preserved as inconclusive, followed by a timing amendment recorded before its measurement. Sensitivity, readable history and useful continuation remain separate claims.

nodes.claim: Tests whether different retained cue histories, under identical present input, make the same delayed ping produce different responses that target each history's own next unmodified settling transition.
nodes.survived: The frozen checkpoint and graph retain cue-order differences after identical present inputs. In 12 declared pairs across four common positions, A,B and B,A receivers respond differently to the same step-3 source ping delivered at step 4; mean relative policy-response separation is 0.233. The source uses a separate present-only prefix and never sees the untouched step-5 target. Erased-history, swapped-pair, affine-reader and 32 matched-ping controls separate response dependence from targeting. Earlier three-position tests also found reader-dependent sensitivity after removing the present-state direction. The complete suite passed 116 tests, including real-artifact integration, and independent review reproduced both first runs.
nodes.killed: Correct continuation targeting fails the declared primary gate: 13/24 policy pairings (54.2%, below 75%), 68.2% matched-control margin percentile (below 95%) and mean native cosine -0.010663. The original two-step source was mathematically annihilated by orthogonalization because step-1 readout was zero; that first run stays inconclusive. The later source-timing correction is disclosed and its amendment predates measurement. Correctness means the model's next untouched internal transition, not stronger chess or a beneficial recurrent intervention. Twelve pairs share four positions and 24 correlated queries; small float32 margins are precision-sensitive. No biological waveform decoding, consciousness or quantum mechanism is established.
nodes.era: Same present, different retained history, identical delayed query

edges.why: ChessFlyStatePings explicitly takes V3's narrow distinction between state present at an event and state readable by a downstream receiver, then tests that distinction in a frozen pretrained artificial network with separate association, policy, and value readouts.
